discourse.excerpt: the giving of bhakthi (devotion to God) in exchange for mukthi (liberation) is the most profitable business of all
discourse.theme: Life is a market of giving and taking — and devotion exchanged for liberation is its most profitable business.
discourse.title: Life's balance sheet

reflection: Swami calls life a market of giving and taking, and says the most profitable business is giving devotion in exchange for liberation. Bhakti is not only worship — it is control of the senses, offered as worship. Today, offer one hour of your day as worship: do it with full attention, without chasing its fruit. (Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 4, 4 Dec 1964)
seva_nudge: Give one hour of unhurried help today — to a neighbour, a family member, or at the centre — and treat the giving itself as the reward.
